# Standalone analyses

## BayesPrism

BayesPrism performs immune deconvolution of a TPM matrix using a single-cell reference.

```bash
iobrpy bayesprism \
  --input "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/03-tpm/tpm_matrix.csv" \
  --output "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/08-bayesprism" \
  --threads 4
```

The output directory contains:

```text
$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/08-bayesprism/
├── theta.csv
├── theta_cv.csv
└── Z_tumor.csv
```

## TME clustering

TME clustering groups samples according to their tumor microenvironment profiles.

```bash
mkdir -p "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/09-tme-cluster"

iobrpy tme_cluster \
  --input "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/05-tme/cibersort_results.csv" \
  --output "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/09-tme-cluster/tme_clusters.csv" \
  --features 1:22 \
  --min_nc 2 \
  --max_nc 5 \
  --print_result
```

## HLA typing

```bash
iobrpy hla_typing \
  -b "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/02-star" \
  -r hg38 \
  -o "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/10-hla" \
  -j 8 \
  -u 1
```

The output directory contains:

```text
$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star/10-hla/
├── ExtractHLAread/<sample>/
├── SpecHLA/<sample>/hla.result.txt
└── hla_result_merged.txt
```
